text: Show that a simple pendulum moves with SHM for small angles, and derive its period.

points.text: The restoring force on the bob is mg sin θ.
For small angles, sin θ ≈ x/l, so F = −(mg/l)x.
This has the form of SHM, with ω² = g/l.
So T = 2π√(l/g).
